messages.todo.skill.todo-advance.description: Use when the user asks to move a specific todo forward. Clarify the next step and blockers, draft useful outputs, and propose status changes without applying them unasked.
messages.todo.skill.todo-advance.name: Advance a todo
messages.todo.skill.todo-advance.when-not-to-use: Don’t use to extract new tasks from material (use Organize todos), or merely to list todos or change status.
messages.todo.skill.todo-advance.when-to-use: The user has a specific todo and wants help drafting messages, preparing questions, writing a brief, or arranging time and reminders.
messages.todo.skill.todo-organize.description: Use when the user wants tasks extracted from mail, files, meeting notes, web pages, or current content, checks for missed tasks, or asks how an email affects plans. Present candidates for confirmation first.
messages.todo.skill.todo-organize.name: Organize todos
messages.todo.skill.todo-organize.when-not-to-use: Don’t use to advance an existing task (use Advance a todo), or simply to add, list, or update a todo.
messages.todo.skill.todo-organize.when-to-use: There is material to turn into tasks, recent incoming material to check for omissions, or an email whose effect on plans needs review.

messages.todo.agent-prompt.todo-organizer.title: Todo organizer
messages.todo.agent-prompt.todo-organize-basic.pu: Identify matters for the user, their commitments, things awaiting others and suggestions to consider, then compare them with existing todos; invent no owner, date, priority or completion state
messages.todo.agent-prompt.todo-organize-organize: Beyond basic organization, find implicit expectations, informal commitments and unassigned actions, distinguish responsibility from participation, and suggest arrangements; invent nothing and write nothing directly
messages.todo.read-group.todo.description: To-dos, their dates and due reminders

messages.todo.archive.restore-hint: Puts it back in its list
messages.todo.help.title: Todo
messages.todo.help.what: Organizes daily tasks across Today, Waiting, Upcoming, and project filters with quick capture and instant undo.
messages.todo.help.example-1: Type a task with a due date to place it into the right view automatically
messages.todo.help.example-2: Filter by project to focus on one workspace and undo accidental completions
messages.todo.help.scope: Stored locally in your personal space with per-project filtering; completions and removals offer immediate undo.
messages.todo.help.advanced: When you ask the assistant to jot down a reminder, it files it here under the right project or personal space.
messages.todo.status.waiting-hint: Handed over, waiting for a reply
messages.todo.place.personal-hint: Yours alone, not part of a project
messages.todo.place.unassigned-hint: Leave it for now, place it later
messages.todo.rail.label: Dates and place
messages.todo.wait.label: Waiting on
messages.todo.wait.hint: Note who and what you’re waiting for; it shows under Today on the follow-up day
messages.todo.link.nothing-to-link: There are no other todos to link
messages.todo.permission.storage-private.reason: Save your to-dos and edit history locally
messages.todo.permission.action.reason: Read, create, or organize to-dos with your access
messages.todo.actions.items-list.title: List to-dos
messages.todo.actions.items-list.description: Lists the to-dos here (your personal space or this project) by view: today, waiting, unscheduled, upcoming, open, or closed.
messages.todo.actions.items-get.title: Read to-do
messages.todo.actions.items-get.description: Reads a to-do’s full details, reminder markers, change history, and linked to-dos.
messages.todo.actions.items-create.title: Create to-do
messages.todo.actions.items-create.description: Adds a new to-do using only dates explicitly given in the text or by you. Retrying the same request won’t create duplicates.
messages.todo.actions.items-update.title: Update to-do
messages.todo.actions.items-update.description: Updates only the specified fields against the version you read, refusing to overwrite newer edits.
messages.todo.actions.items-status.title: Change to-do status
messages.todo.actions.items-status.description: Changes a to-do to open, in progress, waiting, done, or canceled. Only marks an item done or changes status when you confirm.
messages.todo.actions.items-archive.title: Archive or restore to-do
messages.todo.actions.items-archive.description: Archives a completed or canceled to-do, or brings an archived one back without changing its status.
messages.todo.actions.items-delete.title: Delete to-do
messages.todo.actions.items-delete.description: Permanently deletes a to-do and its change history. This can’t be undone.
messages.todo.actions.items-batch.title: Batch update to-dos
messages.todo.actions.items-batch.description: Applies one change (status, dates, defer, or archive) across selected to-dos all at once, with batch undo.
messages.todo.actions.changes-revert.title: Undo to-do changes
messages.todo.actions.changes-revert.description: Undoes a single or batch change if nothing newer modified the item. Undoing a new item removes it.
messages.todo.actions.items-link.title: Link item to to-do
messages.todo.actions.items-link.description: Adds or removes a link between a to-do and a goal, reference, another to-do, artifact, or assistant work.
messages.todo.actions.reminders-due.title: List due reminders
messages.todo.actions.reminders-due.description: Lists unfinished to-dos whose reminder is due and not yet acknowledged, skipping reminders older than 48 hours.
messages.todo.actions.reminders-acknowledge.title: Acknowledge reminder
messages.todo.actions.reminders-acknowledge.descr: Dismisses the current due reminder without changing the to-do or its reminder time.
messages.todo.actions.events.title: To-do activity
messages.todo.actions.events.description: Reads notable to-do activity and links for the current window to show on Home and in briefs, without running any actions.
messages.todo.actions.search-entries.title: List searchable to-dos
messages.todo.actions.search-entries.description: Lists the to-dos here in batches for search indexing. Read-only and doesn’t modify data.
messages.todo.actions.item-subject-read.title: Read to-do details and links
messages.todo.actions.item-subject-read.descripti: Reads a to-do’s current text, version, and links for accurate reference.
messages.todo.actions.composer-pick.title: Pick a to-do reference
messages.todo.actions.composer-pick.description: Searches open to-dos by title to attach as context in the composer.
messages.todo.actions.fragment-offers.title: Offer to-do actions for selection
messages.todo.actions.fragment-offers.description: Prepares ready-to-run to-do actions from your selected snippet without creating anything yet.
messages.todo.actions.organize-extract.title: Extract to-dos from materials
messages.todo.actions.organize-extract.descriptio: Extracts action items, commitments, waiting items, and suggestions from materials, compares them against existing to-dos, and saves a reviewable draft without editing your list.
messages.todo.actions.organize-list.title: List organize results
messages.todo.actions.organize-list.description: Lists pending or recent to-do organize results waiting for your review.
messages.todo.actions.organize-get.title: Read organize result
messages.todo.actions.organize-get.description: Reads an organize result’s candidates, source excerpts, matches with existing to-dos, and extra notes.
messages.todo.actions.organize-apply.title: Apply organize result
messages.todo.actions.organize-apply.description: Applies your choices to add, merge, update, complete, reopen, or skip candidates all at once, with batch undo.
messages.todo.actions.organize-close.title: Close organize result
messages.todo.actions.organize-close.description: Closes this organize result while keeping unhandled candidates intact so you can reopen it later.
messages.todo.actions.batch-subject-read.title: Read organize batch and links
messages.todo.actions.batch-subject-read.descript: Reads an organize result’s current content, version, and links for accurate reference.
messages.todo.actions.onboarding-draft.title: Draft to-dos from starter materials
messages.todo.actions.onboarding-draft.descriptio: Drafts reviewable starter to-dos from your onboarding materials without creating them yet. Retrying returns the same draft.
messages.todo.actions.onboarding-get.title: Read starter to-do drafts
messages.todo.actions.onboarding-get.description: Reads starter to-do drafts and their current review status.
messages.todo.actions.onboarding-keep.title: Keep starter to-dos
messages.todo.actions.onboarding-keep.description: Adds your chosen starter drafts to your to-do list, updating matching items and skipping ones already handled.
messages.todo.actions.placement-export.title: Read a to-do to carry
messages.todo.actions.placement-export.descriptio: Reads one to-do and its change history so it can be carried to another place (the personal space or a project).
messages.todo.actions.placement-put.title: Place a carried to-do
messages.todo.actions.placement-put.description: Places a to-do brought from another place here: a move keeps it the same one, a copy makes a new one.
messages.todo.actions.placement-remove.title: Remove a moved to-do
messages.todo.actions.placement-remove.descriptio: Removes a to-do from here after it moved elsewhere, only while it is still the version that was carried.
